headline: Operations Lead | Logistics & Supply Chain Strategist
summary: Results-driven operations professional with over 12 years of experience in logistics and transport management within Nepal. Proven track record in optimizing fleet performance, streamlining distribution networks, and implementing lean operational frameworks for national delivery services. Expert in cross-functional team leadership and infrastructure development.

experiences.title: Head of Operations
description: Direct the end-to-end logistics operations including last-mile delivery and hub management across 50+ locations in Nepal.
Increased delivery efficiency by 25% through the implementation of a proprietary route optimization algorithm.
Lead a cross-functional team of 150+ staff to maintain a 98% on-time delivery rate during peak promotional events.
Negotiate contracts with third-party logistics providers, reducing operational overhead by 15% annually.

experiences.title: Fleet Operations Manager
description: Managed the maintenance and scheduling for a diverse fleet of over 300 commercial vehicles.
Oversaw the transition to a digital fleet management system, improving vehicle uptime by 20%.
Implemented rigorous safety protocols, resulting in a 40% reduction in vehicle incidents.

experiences.title: Logistics Coordinator
description: Managed ground operations and cargo logistics for domestic flight networks.
Coordinated with warehouse teams in Kathmandu and Pokhara to ensure timely ground handling of critical shipments.
